metadata.name: Multi-State Action Button with Micro-Animations
metadata.description: A highly interactive form submission button built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Transitions smoothly through 'Idle', 'Loading' (with spinner), and 'Success' (with an animated checkmark) states.
